articles.title: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
articles.highlight: 香港法院裁定《华尔街日报》出版商阻挠一名记者担任工会职务，此案引发对该市新闻自由的担忧。
articles.summary: 香港法院认定《华尔街日报》出版商道琼斯一项阻挠记者郑嘉如出任香港记者协会职务的罪名成立，但另一项指控不成立。该报在郑嘉如2024年当选记协主席数周后将其解雇，当时对外称原因是架构重组。此案值得关注，因为它把企业人事决定与新闻自由、劳工权利之间的张力摆上了法庭。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示是：在特定司法辖区，员工参与工会或行业组织可能与企业的人事决定产生法律冲突，雇主以“重组”为由的解雇也可能被法院重新审视，因此人事决策的合规审查不能只看内部理由。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring.

articles.title: Kahlil Gibran on the Courage to Weather the Uncertainties of Love
articles.highlight: 不要以为你能左右爱的走向；爱若认定你配得，便会指引你的道路。
articles.summary: The Marginalian 选取纪伯伦《先知》中论爱的段落，谈论人在爱的不确定面前所需的那份勇气。它提醒读者，爱并不受人指挥，反而会去指引那个值得它的人。对于想从文学与哲思角度重新理解亲密关系的人，这是一段值得慢读的文字。
articles.failureAnalysis: 核心要点：在爱与关系中，想要掌控走向常常只是错觉；把不确定性当作前提接受下来，反而更容易维持勇气与投入。
articles.sourceExcerpt: "Think not you can direct the course of love, for love, if it finds you worthy, directs your course."

articles.sourceExcerpt: NERVE Attacks: Breaking AI-Powered Brain-Computer Interfaces Zahra Tarkhani∗∥, Georgios Akkogiounoglou †∥, Lorena Qendro ‡, Isabel Tscherniak §∥, Anil Madhavapeddy ¶ ∗Microsoft †KTH Royal Institute of Technology ‡Nokia Bell Labs §Technical University of Munich ¶University of Cambridge Abstract—The rapid integration of AI into human-centred systems such as Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) has created a poorly understood attack surface linking neural signals to physical systems. Exploits in this domain threaten cognitive autonomy, mental privacy, and physical safety—from neural data exfiltration to malicious control of BCI-tethered devices. We introduce the NERVE Attacks class, a systematic character- isation of five orthogonal attack dimensions that together span the complete BCI stack: Neuro-mimetic Forgery (N), Evasion via Desynchronization (E), Replay-based Hijacking (R), Vein Tapping (V), and Embedded Backdoors (E).

en.summary: This paper addresses security risks when AI is integrated into brain-computer interfaces, especially the attack surface created when neural signals connect to physical systems. Because the available text is only the opening of the abstract, the specific construction, experimental setup, and impact scope of NERVE attacks are not detailed. Its value lies in signaling that BCI security must consider threats at both the neural-signal and physical-execution layers.

articles.title: Nanako0129/sepia
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 这是 GitHub 上获 2524 星的仓库 sepia，为各类 Agent 提供「去 AI 味」的写作技能，通过 Skills CLI 兼容 77+ 平台，并对 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build、Antigravity 给出原生插件。它同时覆盖小说叙事结构修复与专业文体的场合适配规则，理论上基于 StoryScope（arXiv:2604.03136）。它值得关注，是因为直击 AI 文本「一眼假」这一普遍痛点，且以技能插件形式分发，接入成本低。
articles.failureAnalysis: 去 AI 味本质偏主观风格偏好，缺少可量化的验收标准，用户很难判断效果是否稳定可复现。若模型厂商在底层持续改进文风，这种「事后修补」的价值可能被快速稀释。作为技能与提示层项目，护城河较薄，容易被复制或被平台内置功能吸收；同时 77+ 平台的适配意味着持续的维护成本，2524 星的热度也未必转化为付费或长期留存。此外其引用的 arXiv:2604.03136 需核实，学术背书不足会削弱在专业写作场景中的信任建立。

en.highlight: A de-AI writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent, covering 77+ platforms via the Skills CLI, with native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, and more.
en.summary: sepia is a GitHub repository with 2,524 stars that supplies de-AI writing skills to agents, supporting 77+ platforms through the Skills CLI plus native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Antigravity. It covers narrative-architecture repair for fiction and venue-matched rules for professional prose, grounded in StoryScope (arXiv:2604.03136). It is notable for attacking the common pain of obviously machine-generated text at low integration cost.
en.failureAnalysis: Style de-AI-ification is subjective with no clear acceptance criteria, so users struggle to verify stable results. The moat is thin: model vendors or built-in platform features can absorb it, and maintaining 77+ platform integrations is costly relative to uncertain monetization.
